component.name: EMEET Webcam
component.summary: Control panel with live preview for UVC webcams

description.p: Adjust brightness, contrast, white balance, exposure, focus and zoom of a UVC webcam while watching the live preview, pick the stream format, resolution and frame rate, and save the result as presets. Made for the EMEET SmartCam S600, works with any camera the Linux UVC driver supports.
